page.title: Shares
page.searchPlaceholder: Search by document or folder name…
page.emptyDescription: Share a document or folder from Browse to create a link — it'll show up here.

columns.linkTooltip: The one-time link is only shown right after creation. Revoke and recreate if it was lost.

revokeModal.title: Revoke this share link?
revokeModal.description: Anyone with the link will immediately lose access. This can't be undone — create a new link if you need to share again.

deleteModal.title: Delete this share record?
deleteModal.description: Permanently removes this share and its access log. If the link is still active, revoke it instead to cut access immediately without losing the history.

reauthPrompt.title: Confirm it's you
reauthPrompt.defaultDescription: For your security, please confirm your identity before continuing.
reauthPrompt.googleInvalid: Could not verify your Google identity. Please try again.
reauthPrompt.noMethod: No sign-in method is available to verify your identity. Contact your family admin.

accessLog.title: Access log
accessLog.loadError: Could not load the access log.
accessLog.emptyDescription: Opens and downloads of this link will show up here.

createModal.includeSensitiveDescription: Off by default. When on, anyone with the link and password can see saved passwords/secret values in plain text — a password becomes required and the link can expire in at most 24 hours.
createModal.successNotice: This is the only time the link is shown — copy it now. You can revoke or extend it later from the Shares page.
createModal.passwordProtectedNotice: This link is password-protected — share the password separately from the link itself.
createModal.copyLinkError: Could not copy — select and copy the link manually.
createModal.createError: Could not create the share link.

errors.passwordRequiredForSensitive: A password is required when sharing sensitive fields

notFound.title: Link not found
notFound.description: This share link doesn't exist. Double-check the URL you were given.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.description: Ask whoever shared this with you to send a new link.

revoked.title: This link was revoked
revoked.description: The person who shared this has turned off access. Ask them to send a new link.

locked.title: Too many attempts
locked.description: This link has been temporarily locked after several incorrect passwords. Please try again in about 15 minutes.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: Please try again in a moment.

password.title: Password required
password.description: This link is protected. Enter the password given to you to view it.
